title: Silas and the Garden
author: Orsen Okafor
blurb: Mara Quintana, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the long winter finishes falling.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
